scope: Local development experiment for14deJulho discharge, with frozen15h historical latency features and18h current snapshot. No live replacement or promotion.
features: For each of the same7flow variables, use delayed levels at0,1,3,6h instead of differences/slopes. Retain the same25causal rainfall features. No2023 augmentation and no anomaly masks in this comparison.
solver: Ridge alpha1000, training-only medians/means/scales and missing indicators, weights1+2*(target>2 in1000m3/s). Absolute-flow response for both level models. Constrain coefficients of the53numeric predictors to>=0 in the nonnegative family; missing-indicator coefficients and intercept remain unconstrained. This ensures monotone response holding other inputs and missing flags fixed, not water conservation or a physical upper bound.
intercept: Weighted target mean as in the reference fitter; not independently optimized.
splits: Same chronological boundaries: training targets<2025-10-01; validation origins>=2025-10-01 and targets<2026-07-01; test origins>=2026-07-01 and targets<2026-09-21; final training targets<2026-09-21. Explicit UTC-03.
target_membership: Identical to existing14deJulho experiment for all families. Unknown targets/reference excluded identically; difficult cases retained.
selection: Compare general/high-flow MAE,bias,P90 at each lead and aggregate, with unchanged pre-validation95th-percentile threshold. No hyperparameter search. Previously inspected development periods cannot prove independent improvement.
